description:
We'll visit 4 awesome bars/clubs around West End/ Soho - and go past many of the recognisable hotspots (such as Leicester Square, Piccadilly Circus, Chinatown)
You'll meet up with a group of like-minded party-ers, ready to dive into the night.

Come with me and get:
Free Entry to 4 venues
4 Shots
Drinks Deals all night
Great Host & Photographer for the night
Awesome crowd of people to party with
I'll send you digital copies of the photos a day or two after

Sunday-Thursday it can be hard to find the best places to party, which is why we're here! The West End has a huge range of nightlife gems, which are busy every night. I change up the route each night of the week to ensure we end at the best and busiest club for that day. We start off with smaller bars/pubs to get the night started, before heading to more of the dancey-party venues!

We'll spend around an hour in each place and will get to the last club between 12-12.30. Then you're free to party the night away!
Other things to note
My Crawls are suited mainly to the younger 18-30yrs crowd (though all are welcome!)
The bars are not 'traditional' English Pubs, but more bars & clubs.
Entry is down to venues' discression
hostdescription:
Just under 7 years ago I began Hosting Pub Crawls in London to detract from the boredom of my 9-5 job, only to realise that I LOVE introducing people to London and giving them a great night out - on the cheap! Having worked in clubs and bars around Cental London since I was 18, I am familiar with the best places to visit depending on the night.
My friends and I share nights introducing new people to the best nightlife spots in London - we take it in turns to host party nights visiting our favourite bars and clubs!
locationDescription:
We'll visit a range of venues.

We always start at the same arrival venue, a great place to mingle and get to know your group for the night. Then we will head to 3 (or 4!) more bars/clubs, which all generally get a louder and busier throughout the night, so we can party hard!

Drop me a message if you want to know the expected route for a particular day- otherwise trust me, I’ll take us to some fun party venues!

It was a nice experience if you are on your own or with a friend and want to party. Most of the people participating are because they are willing to socialize and party so it is easy to make friends and to make a group. Just a few recommendations: arrive early and don't separate from your group, otherwise, they won't let you in on the clubs.

I almost cancelled but I’m SO glad I didn’t as I ended up not getting home until after 3am… 200% recommend doing this!! We were a small group but that didn’t stop anyone from having the best time. Everyone was so kind and fun. Being a solo female traveller, I felt totally safe and comfortable. Priya was amazing too and I’m so glad I had her!! x
Had so much fun and got to meet new people from different parts of the world! The tour was well managed and my girlfriend and I felt super safe being two girls on our own! Highly recommend it!

Met up with Anna and she was delightful! I enjoyed every conversation with her and glad she was our host. Would book again! We went to locations total and there was about 15 of us. Was fun meeting everyone!

Booked this sort of last minute. I'm a solo traveler visiting London for the first time. This experience was definitely a good value. Our guide for the evening was Anna. She was very friendly and spent a good amount of time making sure everyone was comfortable and having fun. I can see how this type of experience is shaped by the group you have. I think I was lucky that the stars aligned for an all around fun and memorable night out.

Fun night with lots of interesting venues, fun people to meet, and the hosts were great. However be aware that the venues have the final say on who they let in. I didn't get to join the rest of the group at the last venue, but the hosts suggested another venue that i really enjoyed. All around, would recommend.
such a good night! i went by myself and made friends instantly. the bars we went to played good music, had nice cocktails and a fun vibe. definitely recommend!

Don’t expect that they will guide you through good clean bars and quality drinks or bars with good choices of drinks .
I would not recommend it.

If you want to have a great night while experiencing a bit of London’s night life, book it now!! Totally worth it, had a lot of fun (even on a Sunday, who knew) and would do it again. Connor and Chris were so fun & accommodating, they made sure we all were having fun and a party attitude !!

Bar crawl guides are very friendly and helpful. The bars were hopping and the drink discounts were very nice. Overall this a great experience for those looking to see the night life in London. Great value for the money.

Good for young people who are traveling alone to connect. Just a series of bar/club visits. Don't expect too much from the malls on offer. The second location was really nice the tour could have started with it!

Our host Sabrina was great! She worked hard to make sure everyone was interacting and getting to know each other. When we left one place, she always made sure everyone was present before heading out. She also made sure everyone was having a grand time! It was definitely a great way to make friends in a new city.
There was about 50 people on the crawl and the interacting started out slow but by the 3rd bar everyone was friends. I’d recommend to anyone visiting and wanting to meet new people.
Great opportunity to have a fun night out in London. Some people in the group are typically more open to making new friends but consider not everyone is.

Good to meet some people ! If you excel at socializing come alone, otherwise you might wanna bring a friend, so you have at least one person with you 😅 Hosts were very energetic, nice and helpful. The bars were okay, I‘d say 2 out of the 4 were my vibe, which isn’t bad. As for the free shots at each bar, I feel like only one had alcohol 🙈 Our group was waaay larger than I expected, I thought bar or pub crawls were 20 people at most but we were 64 😬 Gave you lots of options for conversations tho, so all in all the experience is definitely worth it for all the people you’ll be meeting alone !
Fun tour! Recommend if you want to go to some fun bars in London and are traveling alone or with friends and don’t know the lay of the land.
Super fun time!! Most of the clubs were really fun and the free shots were a nice plus. A great way to get out and enjoy london with friends 🥂
It was great. If you want to meet new people and looking fir something to do. i would recommend that everyone. not just tourists. it is for anyone a great experience!
I did this on 4th of July, and there were probably 100+ people, mostly college kids and a few older 20 somethings. Impressive organization herding cats and getting us access to great venues.
I had a great time and you visit some great clubs. Very good for solo travelers. Met a lot of people from various countries.
Had a great time, ton of people. You are left a bit to your own when getting to know each other but if you’re willing to just say hi to someone you’ll be fine!

We are very undecided people, so it was a very good plan! Moreover we met so many funny people and made wonderful memories. It's perfectly organized, we feel so safe with security system and bodyguards who, by the way, are very attentive to not let people who are too drunk in. It's the perfect activity to book if you want to meet people from everywhere in the world and party in safe places, we'll definitely do it again and we recommend you to book it as well!
It was really funny to go to lots of pubs and clubs in London and to meet new people :) Luke was also great !

This experience was a great way to explore the night life of London. I had a great time and Jess, my host was absolutely amazing! She was always there to help and make sure we all are having a great time! Highly recommend!

Amazing night! The hosts were fantastic at introducing everyone and making each person feel included. The expedited entrance + free shots definitely makes this experience a bang for your buck. Overall, this event definitely makes the nightlight experience feel more safe/accessible for newcomers to London and is a great way to meet people from all around the world.

It was fun, but unfortunatley the whole group was big and we didn’t Get the chance to Get to know the others really well than if we were sat together as a group and not seperately. All of the hosts were really Kind and fun tho!
In the case you are visiting the city alone, I recommend you. You will know new people and will joy nice bars and clubs in a great atmosphere.

This was a great experience. Conor made sure everyone felt welcomed and included. He specifically made sure that myself and my friend felt comfortable and even helped us out of an awkward situation with a stranger. Would definitely recommended to anyone if Conor was their guide.
Amazing experience. Connor was a great. Very friendly and got to know everyone in the group. If you are traveling and looking to meet new people this is your guy.

We had Jess and she was amazing!! A fantastic group of people, learned a lot from the others, and got a good feel for London nightlife. At college age, I thought the club choices were perfect, especially for a Sunday night. Started off more chill and gradually got more “club-like” throughout the night. The photos were also a nice touch. Highly recommend!

Arun was a fabulous facilitator for our pub crawl! He helped introduce everyone to each other so we could all get to know each other before we set off.

I made some great friends, including a couple that lives only 30 minutes away from me back home! It's also a fabulous value because you get free shots at all four bars we visited as well as drinks deals like 50% off spirits and mixers like a rum and coke, G&T, or vodka cranberry. The places we visited had a wide variety of atmosphere and music so there was something for everyone. I actually went back to one of the bars the next night for a girl's night with someone I met on the crawl!

Good experience. Met a couple of nice and friendly travelers as well. Some group kinda are just on their own which is okay, I was able to talk and hang out with majority of the other people. Our host Conor was good.

This is a great experience to start out your trip to London! It'll show you great spots to come back to during your stay. It's nice to go out in a new city without having to think or plan out exactly where you'll go. The guides are so fun and set up a great night for you, worry free.

I had a wonderful time on this crawl, especially as a solo traveler. I made loads of friends and went to bars/clubs I wouldn’t have otherwise visited but for this experience. I recommend to anyone, irrespective of age, to buy if you want a night out dancing with a group.
As someone who’s on a solo trip to London, I couldn’t have asked for a better night out meeting new people and feeling safe hopping around bars! I’ll definitely be going again!

If your white this is perfect for you, the people and music. If you’re of colour then don’t waste your time. Also the last venue wouldn’t let me and a Morocco guy in because we was a bit late due to bad directions. I would go again but I would turn up drunk before going so I don’t have to deal with the shit.

It was an amazing experience! Really loved it! It was almost everything perfect, Luke was very friendly and helpful!
Negative points: Somewhat failed communication with hosts.
Hosts can't wait, if it's time to leave and someone is in the bathroom, they'll stay at the bar!
But in the end, the qualities stood out, and I would highly recommend it!
Great experience! Connor was an amazing host. My friend and I had loads of fun! The destinations in Soho were quite fun. Definitely a must do even if you’re in London for one night— like we did!
One hell of a night! I didn’t even last to see the last location. I had an amazing time, made great friends, and was totally worth it!

Left alone when I advised to wait for me for the bathroom , I didn’t had way to contact them and I had to enter in mood gadget inspector to find them (that because they don’t specify their route ) . After Kate gently answered me (not the host ) I did ask for explanation and I was given no face having as answer that it was my fault , they waited three minutes … in any case after the host admitted his fault he promised me a free beer and suddenly stopped to give to me the ticket for discount and free drinks . After that , when my group was left alone in a pub (I don’t know where the host went , it was just midnight ) one of the girl was left alone inside and the ppl outside was not allowed to enter another time to advise her or to take their stuff . I did have been to other pub crawl but that remain the worst experience so far , kudos for Kate and for the ppl at the party

Great club crawl! I think this was the most fun that I had on a Wednesday night. Kate was awesome and this is great way to go to good clubs in London. If you’re a solo traveler or a bit of a group, either way I recommend.

I would highly recommend this experience, especially for solo travelers looking to meet new friends! Kate is just the best! In addition to being a wonderful guide, she made sure everyone in our group was comfortable, safe and had a great time! It was probably the best pub crawl I’ve been to!!

Pub crawl is the best thing that can happen for people travelling to London.. you get to loosen up a bit with some like minded people.. Conor kept the light up and was friendly and engaging with people

This tour was a blast! We went to 5 rockstar venues and received complimentary mixed shot at each location—definitely worth the price! The cherry on top was being able to meet other travelers from around the world looking to hav a good night in London :) Conor our host was very personable and made sure we were all together when we walked to the next venue.
